_doc_launch_action: One-icon model: the forks ship WITHOUT a launcher icon (their branding patch removes the MAIN/LAUNCHER category), so the Cloud-Comms hub is the only home-screen icon. Each fork instead declares an exported, signature-gated intent-filter for this action on its main activity; the hub (and SuperApp's openInApp) open a fork via Intent(launch_action).setPackage(<fork app id>). The optional thread-id extra (com.diegonmarcos.comms.extra.THREAD_ID) deep-links a conversation.
_doc: The on-device IPC contract between the Cloud-Comms hub and Cloud-SuperApp (and between the hub and each fork exporter). THE source of truth: hub/SuperApp/fork Kotlin constants mirror this file; `./build.sh verify-contract` validates it against comms-ipc-v1.schema.json. Only body PREVIEWS cross the boundary — full content stays in the owning app and is reached via the openInApp AIDL action (deep link). version is breaking: never edit v1 in place, add v2.

tables._doc: ContentProvider tables. The hub exposes them under `authority`; each fork exporter exposes the same column shapes under its own authority (com.diegonmarcos.comms.<domain>.provider) and the hub UNIONs them. Every row carries `domain` so a single cursor can interleave mail/chat/matrix. `_ts` columns are epoch-millis longs.

aidl._doc: Bound service for actions + push callbacks (the write/live half the read-only ContentProvider can't do). Gated by the same signature permission. Survives Doze (bound service, not a socket). Method/callback signatures here are mirrored exactly in hub/src/main/aidl/.

states._doc: Allowed values for accounts.state / summary sync state / onSyncStateChanged.
